candidate.title: CLaP
candidate.scope: The middle CLaP row of the supplied Illumina schematic: cell labeling via photobleaching coupled to single-cell mRNA sequencing. PAIR above and CytoSeq below are neighboring rows, not alternative CLaP workflows. The final combined downstream block is resolved only at its cell-to-indexed-cDNA-to-readout interface, using the primary CLaP paper; unshown applications are outside scope.

operations.label: Tagged cells isolated, reverse-transcribed and sequenced
operations.description: Library-producing portion of the combined source caption: isolate tagged individual cells, release their RNA and reverse-transcribe mRNA into amplified cDNA, then prepare indexed DNA libraries. The primary paper resolves this interface as C1 single-cell capture/cDNA processing followed by Nextera XT indexed library preparation. These named components are not additional target methods.
operations.mechanism: The surface tag permits recognition of CLaP-positive cells; the paper captures and visually identifies single cells on a C1 device, then converts their mRNA to cDNA in separate reactions. Indexes are introduced during subsequent DNA library preparation.
operations.information_effect: Maintain the captured-cell/sample association through separate processing and library indexing. The tag selects cells for transcriptome profiling; no transfer of cell-surface biotin or fluorophore into a sequence barcode is depicted or reported.

method_scopes.rationale: The card title, supplied middle-row label and verified CLaP primary paper resolve the target as CLaP (cell labeling via photobleaching). All listed operations belong to that depicted route. The single-cell-to-poly(A)-RNA icon at the left summarizes the target and readout; it is not an extra RNA-extraction step. The collection-page candidate is confirmed by its CLaP heading and matching workflow labels, despite a stray PAIR caption. PAIR above and CytoSeq below in the supplied image are separate rows. The final combined caption is retained on two local instances to expose the indexed-library-to-sequence-data interface; no detailed internal library-preparation recipe or separate FACS branch is inferred. The diagram specifies Cy5-streptavidin; paper support establishes the common biotin/streptavidin selection and single-cell RNA interface without asserting complete equivalence to every conjugate or CLaP application.

checks.rationale: Independent inspection supports the declared CLaP schematic architecture. All nine states, six local operations, fourteen routes, two paper assessments, the method scope, and the carrier correction were checked. The left single-cell/poly(A) RNA drawing is an assay summary rather than a transfer into the culture workflow. Every CLaP transformation and its endpoint is represented; no alternative branch is drawn in this row. The two multi-input instances are actual reagent addition/binding to one culture, not collapsed independent processing. Cell compartments persist through labeling, then individual cells are captured and converted to separately maintained cDNA samples before indexed DNA libraries are pooled. Thus methods=[CLaP], content_checked, and supports_architecture are warranted by inspected content rather than metadata alone. Cell tracking, DNA/PCR validation, flow cytometry, and adhesion applications do not expand this schematic’s scope.

evidence.locator: Abstract, b00002: named method and genomic application
evidence.quote: Here we introduce cell labelling via photobleaching (CLaP), a method that enables instant, specific tagging of individual cells based on a wide array of criteria such as shape, behaviour or positional information.

evidence.locator: Results > Cell labelling, b00008: B4F addition before targeted illumination
evidence.quote: Biotin-4-fluorescein (B4F) is added to the cell culture medium and a laser, tuned near the absorption peak of the dye, is then focused on individual cells of choice, generating reactive oxygen species in close vicinity of the plasma membrane that lead to biotin crosslinking (Supplementary Note 1).

evidence.locator: Figure 1a caption, b00106: rinsing, retained attachment, and fluorescent revelation
evidence.quote: After rinsing, only illuminated cells retain biotin molecules on their plasma membrane and are revealed with fluorescent streptavidin.

evidence.locator: Results > Single-cell isolation and genomics, b00015: CLaP-positive cell transcriptomics
evidence.quote: We then demonstrated that single-CLaP-positive cells can be isolated from a large population for single-cell transcriptomic analyses, using a human retinal pigment epithelial cell line.

evidence.locator: Methods > RNA sequencing, b00056: individual-cell compartment and inspection
evidence.quote: Briefly, viable single cells were captured on a 17–25 μm ‘C1 Single-Cell Auto Prep Integrated Fluid Circuit (IFC)' for mRNA-Seq (Fluidigm 100–5761) and visually confirmed using EVOS FL Auto microscope (Life Technologies).

evidence.locator: Methods > RNA sequencing, b00056: conversion of cDNA samples to indexed DNA libraries
evidence.quote: On benchtops, cDNA samples were converted to sequence ready libraries using the Nextera XT DNA Sample Preparation (Illumina FC-131-1096) and Index Kit (Illumina FC-131-1002).

evidence.locator: Methods > RNA sequencing, b00056: library pooling followed by DNA sequencing
evidence.quote: Equal amount of tagmented cDNA was then pooled from each sample and sequenced on an Illumina HiSeq2500 with paired-end option.

checks.rationale: The source distinction is preserved: the diagram says Barcoded mRNA from single cells and explicitly mentions reverse transcription, while primary methods identify amplified cDNA and indexed DNA libraries as the sequenced carrier. The candidate correction is realized consistently in s_library, o_library, o_sequence, both linking material routes, and the final data output. Separate per-cell reactions followed by indexing and library pooling justify sample-to-cell association as an interpretation; the optical B4F/streptavidin mark is not asserted to become the nucleotide index. The paper-supported resolution therefore corrects the carrier wording without replacing the drawn route or adding another workflow.
